item.description:
## Sibelius and MuseScore - Export a groove, song chart or worksheet to Sibelius, MuseScore, Dorico or Finale: File > Export (Command-E), the Sibelius button above the notation or in Chart Builder, or the Export button on the worksheet. - It opens as an editable drum set part with your stickings, accents, flams, ghost notes, hi-hat "o" and "+", triplets, sections, repeats and 1st/2nd time bars. - Import a drum part saved from Sibelius or MuseScore (File > Export > MusicXML there): as a whole new song chart in Chart Builder, or as the first 4 bars of a groove.
## Writing fills - New "Bar voice" menu next to Clear bar: move every hand note in the bar to stems up (or down, or back to Auto) in one step, triplets included. Kick and hi-hat foot stay below. - Drums in the upper voice keep the note value you entered: an 8th snare no longer turns into a quarter note. - Rests never cross a beat, and half rests start where the gap starts, clear of the notes.
## Worksheets - Stickings can be printed on worksheets (Stickings button, on by default). - The worksheet header is tidier: Library, Save/Delete Template and Print are now icons (hover for the name), so the other buttons show in full.
## Also since 133 - Worksheets: double-click an exercise to edit it on the grid, drag cards to reorder, rename with the pencil. - Print: no blank last page, exercises centred, dotted-rest dots in the right place. - Hi-hat foot close with a "+" above it, and sticking letters kept clear of other marks. - Song Chart Builder tempo slider and drag-to-change tempo; safer saving; undo goes back 100 steps.
This build is 150.
